# CurrentScope

> A mountable Rails engine (Rails >= 8.1, < 9) for authorization: permissions
> auto-derived from controller#action routes, roles as editable data,
> per-record scoped roles, an opt-in separation-of-duties veto (initiator
> can never approve their own record), and one ambient context so
> allowed_to? works identically in controllers, views, and components.
> Fail-closed: no grant means denied. Status: Beta. Built for
> experimentation and report-mode pilots while remaining security items
> are hardened. Run :report, read bin/rails current_scope:report, then
> flip to :enforce. #116 closes after that bake.

Key facts agents get wrong without reading:
- The gate covers EVERY action; skip it on sessions/webhooks with
  skip_before_action :current_scope_check! or sign-in breaks.
- Separation of duties is OFF by default (config.sod_actions = []).
- An SoD member action must return its record from current_scope_record,
  or the veto is silently skipped.
- An SoD action on a model with no current_scope_initiator RAISES (500),
  in report mode too — report mode downgrades a missing grant, never a
  misconfiguration.
- config.actor_method is security-critical the moment the host impersonates.
- Retrofit existing apps through config.enforcement = :report first.
- config.subject_identity is the portable key (column, composite, or
  identify/resolve object). config.subject_label is display-only. They
  are not the same knob. Duplicate identity keys raise. resolve never
  inserts. PLACEHOLDER=1 is refused in production.

## Docs

- [Overview](https://davidteren.github.io/current_scope/index.md): Product pitch, resolver order, comparison, six-step install
- [Is it the right fit?](https://davidteren.github.io/current_scope/comparison.md): CurrentScope vs Pundit, Action Policy, CanCanCan, Banken, Oso; when to choose one of them instead; adoption cost for greenfield vs an existing app
- [Quickstart](https://davidteren.github.io/current_scope/quickstart.md): install, gate skip, report mode, bootstrap admin
- [Adopting in an existing app](https://davidteren.github.io/current_scope/adopting-in-an-existing-app.md): retrofit an existing app through report mode
- [Concepts](https://davidteren.github.io/current_scope/concepts.md): resolver order, permissions from routes, ambient context
- [Concepts & glossary](https://davidteren.github.io/current_scope/concepts-and-glossary.md): decision order and core vocabulary
- [Checking permissions](https://davidteren.github.io/current_scope/checking-permissions.md): allowed_to?, scope_for, record-level grants, scopeable models
- [Separation of duties](https://davidteren.github.io/current_scope/separation-of-duties.md): the anti-fraud veto — opt-in, how to enable, verify, break-glass
- [SoD & break-glass](https://davidteren.github.io/current_scope/separation-of-duties-and-break-glass.md): SoD veto, sod_identity, allow_sod_bypass
- [Security & production checklist](https://davidteren.github.io/current_scope/security-checklist.md): excluded controllers, 403/404 record oracle, pre-ship list
- [Configuration](https://davidteren.github.io/current_scope/configuration.md): every knob with defaults
- [Configuration reference](https://davidteren.github.io/current_scope/configuration-reference.md): initializer knobs, enforcement, audit, diagnostics
- [Portable role definitions](https://davidteren.github.io/current_scope/role-definitions.md): export, diff, import, and rollback of role grids (not assignments)
- [Impersonation](https://davidteren.github.io/current_scope/impersonation.md): act-as, mutation guard, denial shape, actor_method
- [Testing](https://davidteren.github.io/current_scope/testing.md): TestHelpers, grants in request and system specs
- [Upgrading](https://davidteren.github.io/current_scope/upgrading.md): posture-changing upgrades
- [For AI agents](https://davidteren.github.io/current_scope/ai-agents.md): copy-paste integration prompts, including subject identity
- [Limitations](https://davidteren.github.io/current_scope/limitations.md): SSR-first stance and intentional residuals
